text.content:
The station that never stopped

A flat voice reading groups of five, on the same band, since before the Turning. Nobody has found the transmitter and nobody has decoded it. Numbers Signals learned to read along — and at some point, something on the other end started leaving gaps for them.

Enemies in range take a −1 status penalty to Will saves. They are being counted, and on some level they know it.

7th — Off-Book: once per round, an enemy in range that fails a save against your spell is also off-guard until the end of its next turn.
15th — The Gap: spend 3 Encore to force one creature in range to attempt a Will save against your spell DC; on a failure it treats its next check as its lowest possible result. The station reads its number.
